additional_info.body:
Dear Furkan,
We checked the logs and found the following:
As you can see there was a shut down performed on the charger. The charger will not came online on it's own.
But in SCB we can see that the charger is online again.
Please let me know if you have performed any activity on site to reestablish the connection.
Thank you,
Best Regards,
Marcelo

Yes I performed an activity today earlier afternoon. I took the red cross bridge out and inserted it again. After that pressed FC12 and it turned on.

additional_info.subject: ID0451395-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001136] Shut down logo CRM:02681000891
additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan,
Thank you for your feedback.
I see that the charger is offline again:
As you can see there is no indication on the logs about a failure. this can only mean one of 3 possible scenarios:
Electrical grid
Medium voltage cabinet
PLC crashed (very unlikely)
I look forward for your feedback.
Thank you.
Best Regards,
Marcelo
